description: Use when you need web page to markdown, url to markdown, to scrape a web page or extract content from a url for an LLM. Do not use for pages that need JavaScript to render, sit behind a login or paywall, or are not HTML (PDFs go to blackwood_pdf_extract). Returns JSON with the clean Markdown of a public web page (URL to Markdown, boilerplate stripped) plus its title, description, language, canonical URL and links for 0.01 USDC per call. Typical response time 2500 ms (p95). Category: Data.

maxChars.description: Maximum length of the returned markdown (500-100000 characters, 50000 when omitted)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the web page to read, e.g. https://example.com/article

name: blackwood_webpage_markdown

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Web page to Markdown
